findings.text: The brief asked for one lowercase getter per class (`get jsonl()` …); the work used one method, `_helper("Jsonl")`, instead (Page.class.js:96). The reasons are real and logged in session.jsonl: `previews` and `prefs` are already Page methods, `columns`, `related` and `links` are page words or card fields, and `Item.describe()` would list any public getter as a settable field. The mastermind accepted the change, so this is not a fix.

The own-Map guard (`Object.hasOwn(this, "_helpers")`, Page.class.js:97) is right and needed. `Template.clone()` reads through to its template, so without the guard a clone would reuse a helper whose `page` is the template.

Sharing is safe as checked. Each helper's only instance field is `page` (Jsonl.js:17, Columns.js:8, Previews.js:8, Links.js:9, Related.js:6). Prefs adds `prefix` plus an optional `id`, and no caller sets either on `page.prefs()`: a grep for `prefs().assign|id|prefix` finds nothing. Prefs.key() reads `page.url` / `store_key` on every call, so a page that moves still gets the right key.
`_helpers` is never saved: Item.toJSON() (Item.js:266) emits only `type`, `id`, `data` and lists, and `skipped()` (Item.js:15) drops `_` names. Nothing outside Page.class.js reads `_helpers`.

The counts agree: 46 forwarders converted out of the brief's 47 (Jsonl 24, Columns 10, Previews 6, Links 4, Related 1, Prefs 1). The 47th is Frame, which is a View that draws fresh DOM on every render, so it correctly stays `new`. The minion logged tests (Page 2/2, Item 4/4) and smoke (0 FAIL) as matching before and after. I did not re-run them.

One small cost of the string key: `_helper("Jsonl")` with a typo fails only when it runs (`this.constructor[name]` is undefined), where a getter would show up in a grep or an editor. Step 3 picks the public names, so this is fine for now.
